domain: DataForSEO v3 API mastery - 12 modules and ~200+ endpoints (SERP, Keywords Data, AI Optimization, Domain Analytics, DataForSEO Labs, OnPage, Backlinks, Content Analysis, Merchant, App Data, Business Data, Databases), the task/live queue execution model, and the per-call cost model.
refresh_cadence: monthly for endpoint, parameter, and pricing drift; before every release for cost and authentication claims

researched_requires: at least two captured sources for fast-moving or high-stakes domains
at least one official/primary source for lower-risk domains
retrieved dates, refresh_due dates, source_type, confidence, and claim coverage

sources.title: DataForSEO API v3 documentation
claims: DataForSEO v3 has 583 documented endpoints across 11 data APIs plus Appendix (catalog built from the official OpenAPI spec and docs index, 2026-11-06)
Base production URL is https://api.dataforseo.com/v3; sandbox is https://sandbox.dataforseo.com/v3
Docs index for agents: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/llms.txt

sources.title: DataForSEO pricing
claims: Pay-as-you-go: $50 minimum top-up, balance never expires, $1 trial credit for new accounts
SERP modes are Standard queue, Priority queue and Live; Google Organic is $0.0006 / $0.0012 / $0.002 per SERP of 10 results

sources.title: Pricing Update in DataForSEO APIs
claims: Official notice dated July 1, 2026: adjusted rates across eight APIs, about +20% standard, with endpoint exceptions (+7% Google Hotel Searches Task POST, +18.2% Content Analysis Rating Distribution, +22% Google Trends Explore, +18% Lighthouse, +50% Amazon Products and Sellers Task POST)
All endpoints moved to pay-as-you-go; the $100 monthly commitments for Backlinks API and LLM Mentions API were removed

sources.title: DataForSEO authentication
claims: HTTP Basic auth using base64(login:password)
API password is generated automatically in the API Access tab and differs from the account password

sources.title: DataForSEO status & error codes
claims: 20000 Ok, 20100 Task Created; 40xxx client and 50xxx server codes
Account rate limit 10000 calls per minute (40202); at most 30 simultaneous requests (40209); live tasks time out after 120 seconds (50401)
Spend errors: 40200 payment required, 40203 cost limit exceeded, 40210 insufficient funds
task_post takes up to 100 tasks per call (per endpoint docs)

sources.title: DataForSEO sandbox
claims: Sandbox at sandbox.dataforseo.com is free for registered users and returns dummy data with the same structure as production, including pingback and postback
Production Standard results can be collected free for 30 days after task_post; HTML results for 7 days (task_get docs)

sources.title: DataForSEO user_data
claims: GET /v3/appendix/user_data is free and returns balance, prices, rates and limits for the account
Its pricing data covers the base cost only, not extra-charge parameters

sources.title: DataForSEO Labs overview
claims: Labs serves pre-indexed keyword, competitor and market data through Live POST only

Labs Google, Amazon, App Store and Google Play endpoints cost $0.012 per task + $0.00012 per item (pricing page, 2026-11-06); historical endpoints $0.12 + $0.0012; include_clickstream_data doubles cost

sources.title: DataForSEO SERP API overview
claims: SERP API covers Google, Bing, YouTube, Baidu, Yahoo, Seznam and Naver
Methods: task_post, tasks_ready, task_get (Standard and Priority queues) or Live; result types regular, advanced, html
Google Events is deprecated (no longer available)

sources.title: DataForSEO Backlinks API overview
claims: Backlinks API is Live POST; bulk endpoints take up to 1000 targets
Pay-as-you-go since 2026-07-01: $0.024 per request + $0.000036 per row (pricing page, 2026-11-06)
Historical: a live probe on 2026-07-08 returned 20000 Ok for summary/live and bulk_ranks/live (not re-run; no paid calls on 2026-11-06)

sources.title: DataForSEO OnPage API overview
claims: OnPage runs a task-based crawl plus instant_pages, content_parsing, page_screenshot and Lighthouse
Crawl and instant_pages cost $0.00015 per page; Lighthouse $0.005 per task (pricing page, 2026-11-06)

sources.title: DataForSEO AI Optimization API overview
claims: AI Optimization covers LLM Responses, LLM Scraper, LLM Mentions and AI Keyword Data
LLM Mentions is pay-as-you-go since 2026-07-01 at $0.10 per request + $0.001 per row; platforms google and chat_gpt, chat_gpt US only

llm_mentions/search/live is legacy, replaced by llm_mentions/search_mentions/live (also aggregated_metrics to target_metrics, cross_aggregated_metrics to multi_target_metrics, top_domains to top_mentioned_domains, top_pages to top_mentioned_pages)

sources.title: DataForSEO MCP server
claims: Official MCP server is v3 (npm dataforseo-mcp-server 3.1.3, 2026-10-02, Node 22 or newer) with 4 generic tools: docs_index, docs_list_sections, docs_search, api_request
Configured with DATAFORSEO_LOGIN (alias DATAFORSEO_USERNAME) and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD; ENABLED_MODULES no longer exists; hosted at https://mcp.dataforseo.com/v3/mcp with OAuth
api_request has no cost guard and only reaches api.dataforseo.com (no sandbox); the 10-module v2 server is deprecated

provenance: Populated 2026-06-26 from official docs.dataforseo.com/v3 + a $5-capped live API test pass. Updated 2026-07-08 for the 2026-07-01 pay-as-you-go move and live Backlinks/LLM Mentions re-probe.
